title: Append a mandatory “General Terms of Sale and Warranty” page to every orçamento PDF/printout

requirements.text: Update the orçamento print/PDF generation so that every generated output always includes an extra A4 page appended after the orçamento page containing exactly the user-provided Portuguese text “CONDIÇÕES GERAIS DE VENDA E GARANTIA …” (verbatim, preserving line breaks and bullet structure as much as possible).

quotes: sim, o orcamento como está está otimo, so queria que em qualquer orcamento que eu fizesse, aparecesse a pagina extra aseguir com esse texto. podes adicionar ao draft

acceptanceCriteria: From the orçamento PDF/print dialog, generating/printing any orçamento results in at least 2 pages: (1) the existing orçamento layout unchanged, (2) a new appended page containing the full provided terms text.
The appended page text matches the user-provided content exactly (no omissions or edits), and renders with preserved paragraphing/line breaks (e.g., via CSS white-space handling).
The new terms page is included regardless of orçamento contents (items, observations, desconto/IVA, etc.).

requirements.text: If an additional image page is currently appended via imagemAdicional, ensure the new “General Terms” page is still always present and that page ordering is deterministic: orçamento page first, then the new terms page, then (if present) the imagemAdicional page.

quotes: Basta agora **adicionar uma nova página no final**, contendo exatamente esse texto das condições gerais.
sim, o orcamento como está está otimo, so queria que em qualquer orcamento que eu fizesse, aparecesse a pagina extra aseguir com esse texto.

acceptanceCriteria: When imagemAdicional exists, printing generates 3 pages in order: orçamento, terms text page, imagemAdicional page.
When imagemAdicional does not exist, printing generates 2 pages in order: orçamento, terms text page.

constraints: Do not change or break the existing orçamento page layout/formatting (only append the new page).
Do not edit any files under frontend/src/components/ui or any other frontend immutable paths listed in SYSTEM_CONTEXT.
nonGoals: Adding UI controls to toggle/show/hide the terms page (it must always be appended).
Translating the provided terms text to another language.
Implementing a true PDF binary generator on the backend; keep using the existing HTML + window.print approach.
